prose: Techmeme's carry of Anthropic's analysis: GLM-5.3, the latest model from Zhipu AI (Z.ai), can autonomously build working end-to-end cyber exploits - the same capability Anthropic demonstrated with Claude Mythos Preview five months ago - but, Anthropic says, was released without robust safeguards against misuse. See the sibling summary of Anthropic's full Frontier Red Team post for the evaluation details.
highlights: Anthropic: GLM-5.3 builds working exploits end to end
Capability parity with Claude Mythos Preview, per Anthropic
Released without robust misuse safeguards, Anthropic says
Techmeme carry of Anthropic's post; sibling entry has the full analysis
